lines.zh: 背上这对鞘翅，走路总刮墙。
lines.en: These elytra on my back scrape every wall I pass.

lines.zh: 地上走太慢，我宁愿上塔。
lines.en: Walking the ground is slow; I would rather take the tower.

lines.zh: 皮革带勒过胸口，痕早就淡了。
lines.en: Leather straps cut my chest; the grooves long faded.

lines.zh: 翅膀收着，压得肩膀往前倾。
lines.en: Folded wings tip my shoulders forward.

lines.zh: 从这道梁走到那道梁，我熟了。
lines.en: Beam to beam, this route is worn into my feet.

lines.zh: 脚步放轻，影子才不会先到。
lines.en: Keep the steps light so my shadow does not arrive first.

lines.zh: 鞘翅干裂，得抹点脂油。
lines.en: The elytra is cracking and needs a rub of fat.

lines.zh: 地面是别人的，高处才是我的。
lines.en: The ground is someone else's field; height is mine.

lines.zh: 别跟着我走，我在找起跳点。
lines.en: Do not follow; I am hunting for a launch point.

lines.zh: 下界的热浪托着翅膀，很好用。
lines.en: Nether heat lifts these wings nicely.

lines.zh: 百格的路，我用飞的省一半。
lines.en: A hundred paces shrinks by half when I fly.

lines.zh: 甲片贴住翅膀，声音被压住了。
lines.en: Plate pressed to wing muffles the sound.

lines.zh: 我在看塔与塔之间的风往哪吹。
lines.en: I am reading which way the wind runs between towers.

lines.zh: 翅膀上补了七处，都是箭穿的。
lines.en: Seven patches on these wings, all from arrows.

lines.zh: 从这高度跳下去，落地要滚一圈。
lines.en: From this height I roll once on landing.

lines.zh: 禁堡的塔尖，是我最喜欢的位置。
lines.en: The bastion spire is my favorite perch.

lines.zh: 腰间的钩子，还没用上过。
lines.en: The hook at my belt has never been used.

lines.zh: 抬头看天，我在记云的位置。
lines.en: Looking up, I am noting where the clouds sit.

lines.zh: 风一大，翅膀会自己张开。
lines.en: When the wind rises, the wings open on their own.

lines.zh: 血厚不是本事，落点准才是。
lines.en: Toughness is not skill; a precise landing is.

lines.zh: 这套甲是为了摔，不是为了挡。
lines.en: This armor is for falling, not for blocking.

lines.zh: 我在等塔下的火把熄一盏。
lines.en: I wait for one torch below to go out.

lines.zh: 你站在我的落点上，真是巧。
lines.en: You are standing on my landing spot; what luck.

lines.zh: 抬头看，翅膀的影子里有我。
lines.en: Look up; I am inside the shadow of my wings.

lines.zh: 你手里那根杆子，够得到高处吗。
lines.en: That pole in your hand: does it reach high places?

lines.zh: 别数我的翅膀，数你的退路。
lines.en: Do not count my wings; count your exits.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我数了你的步子。
lines.en: While you looked up, I counted your steps.

lines.zh: 耳朵在动，是听风还是听我。
lines.en: Your ears twitch: listening to the wind or to me?

lines.zh: 你该往上看，地面没有答案。
lines.en: You should look upward; the ground holds no answers.

lines.zh: 这身甲上有摔痕，都是我的勋章。
lines.en: These fall marks on my plate are my medals.

lines.zh: 你再退两步，正好在塔影里。
lines.en: Two steps back and you are inside the tower's shadow.

lines.zh: 我看人先看头顶，从不看眼睛。
lines.en: I size people up at the crown, never the eyes.

lines.zh: 翼骨响了一声，不是好响。
lines.en: My wing bone cracked, and not a good crack.

lines.zh: 甲挡住了，落地时还是会疼。
lines.en: Plate stopped it; the landing still hurts.

lines.zh: 你砍到带子，翅膀歪了。
lines.en: You cut the strap; the wing hangs crooked.

lines.zh: 这一下飞不起来了，得走。
lines.en: That grounded me for now; I must walk.

lines.zh: 摔痕上又添一道，习惯了。
lines.en: Another mark on old fall scars; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 血够多，你得多打几下。
lines.en: I have blood to spare; you will need more hits.

lines.zh: 别以为打中翅膀就赢了。
lines.en: Do not think hitting a wing wins this.

lines.zh: 我从更高处摔过更重的。
lines.en: I have fallen from higher and harder.

lines.zh: 扣带松了，我一边打一边系。
lines.en: The buckle loosened; I fight while refastening it.

lines.zh: 这一击，记在我下次的落点上。
lines.en: That strike goes into my next landing.

lines.zh: 那卷皮革，正好补我的翼膜。
lines.en: That roll of leather would patch my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 金锭不错，但翅膀更缺脂油。
lines.en: Gold is fine, but my wings lack oil more.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我却在看风向。
lines.en: You raise food, but I am watching the wind.

lines.zh: 羽毛？鞘翅只认膜，不认羽。
lines.en: Feathers? Elytra trust membrane, never feathers.

lines.zh: 这一小块下界残骸，能补骨架。
lines.en: This scrap of netherite could brace the frame.

lines.zh: 把线给我，翼缝裂了三指。
lines.en: Pass the thread; a wing seam split three fingers wide.

lines.zh: 金锭换不到落点，脂油可以。
lines.en: Gold cannot buy my landing spot; oil can.

lines.zh: 你把东西放高处，我才会考虑。
lines.en: Put it somewhere high and I will consider it.

lines.zh: 那壶油闻起来像蜂蜡，很好。
lines.en: That flask smells of beeswax; very good.

lines.zh: 别抛，抛起来的东西我会扑。
lines.en: Do not toss it; tossed things make me dive.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你会先摸到翅膀的骨。
lines.en: Hit me and your hand finds the wing's bone first.

lines.zh: 让开，我的翼展比这条道宽。
lines.en: Clear out; my wingspan exceeds this walkway.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我连步子都没停。
lines.en: That bump did not even slow my stride.

lines.zh: 你碰歪了翼骨，我得重绑。
lines.en: You knocked the wing bone crooked; I must re-lash it.

lines.zh: 别拽我的带子，那是保命的。
lines.en: Do not pull that strap; it keeps me alive.

lines.zh: 我落地时撞到的东西，多半会倒。
lines.en: Whatever I hit on landing tends to fall.

lines.zh: 翅膀弹开时，力道比手大。
lines.en: When the wings snap open, they push harder than a hand.

lines.zh: 靠太近，你会被翼尖划到。
lines.en: Any closer and the wingtip will cut you.

lines.zh: 不是故意撞，这走廊实在太窄。
lines.en: Not on purpose; this corridor is simply too narrow.

lines.zh: 退开三步，我要试翼。
lines.en: Three steps back; I am testing the wings.

lines.zh: 帮我按住翼骨，我要上油。
lines.en: Hold the wing bone while I oil it.

lines.zh: 我们的窝要开两个口，一个朝火。
lines.en: Our roost needs two openings, one facing the fire.

lines.zh: 你飞得比我稳，落点却偏了。
lines.en: You fly steadier than I, but land further off.

lines.zh: 别把翅膀压在身下睡。
lines.en: Do not sleep with your wings pinned beneath you.

lines.zh: 一起守塔顶，风大也不换位。
lines.en: We hold the spire together, whatever the wind.

lines.zh: 孩子第一次滑翔，得从低处放。
lines.en: A child's first glide should start low.

lines.zh: 你的甲太响，夜飞会暴露。
lines.en: Your plate rings too loud for a night flight.

lines.zh: 替我把背扣系紧，我够不着。
lines.en: Tighten the back buckle; I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 两个落点，总要留一个给对方。
lines.en: Two landing spots, and one is always kept for the other.

lines.zh: 翼膜破了别硬撑，喊我。
lines.en: If the membrane tears, do not force it; call me.

lines.zh: 这段绳子，能绑三根翼骨。
lines.en: This length of cord will lash three wing bones.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的箭头，我留着补膜。
lines.en: Arrowheads on the ground: I keep them for membrane work.

lines.zh: 皮革碎片，比金子值钱。
lines.en: Scraps of leather are worth more than gold here.

lines.zh: 这块布，正合做一块翼补丁。
lines.en: This cloth is just right for a wing patch.

lines.zh: 谁丢的钩子？我正好缺一个。
lines.en: Whose hook is this? I am missing exactly one.

lines.zh: 甲片捡起来，还能垫肩。
lines.en: Pick up that plate; it can pad a shoulder.

lines.zh: 地上的油壶，摇一摇还有声。
lines.en: An oil flask on the ground still sloshes.

lines.zh: 碎骨别踩，我要磨成针。
lines.en: Do not step on the bone shards; I grind them into needles.

lines.zh: 熔岩边的皮子，得快点捡。
lines.en: Leather near lava must be grabbed quickly.

lines.zh: 我捡东西，从来是俯冲下去拿。
lines.en: When I collect something, I always dive for it.

lines.zh: 那个抬头的，我看见他的下巴了。
lines.en: The one looking up: I can see his chin.

lines.zh: 百格之内，你走不出我的视野。
lines.en: Within a hundred paces you stay in my sight.

lines.zh: 你手里的盾，挡不住上方。
lines.en: That shield in your hand does not cover above.

lines.zh: 塔影移了，我的角度也换了。
lines.en: The tower shadow moved, and so did my angle.

lines.zh: 你踩在开阔地上，这是邀请。
lines.en: Standing in the open like that is an invitation.

lines.zh: 这个人的甲缝朝上，我看得清。
lines.en: His armor seams face upward; I see them clearly.

lines.zh: 屋檐挡得住雨，挡不住俯冲。
lines.en: An eaves blocks rain, not a dive.

lines.zh: 你在数箭，我已在算落点。
lines.en: You count arrows; I have already picked the landing point.

lines.zh: 他从左边绕，我从上面来。
lines.en: He circles left; I come from above.

lines.zh: 跑得快的那个，先放他两步。
lines.en: The fast one gets two steps of rope, then I fall.

lines.zh: 你举火把，是给空降兵指路。
lines.en: Holding that torch guides the paratrooper in.

lines.zh: 锁定了，翅膀就不收了。
lines.en: Locked on; the wings will not fold now.

lines.zh: 那个蹲下的，头顶正好空着。
lines.en: The one crouching leaves the top of his head bare.

lines.zh: 你数天上的影子，漏了我一个。
lines.en: You counted the shadows in the sky and missed one.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕圈，你听得到风声。
lines.en: I circle overhead; you can hear the wind.

lines.zh: 等你走到塔与塔之间，风帮我。
lines.en: Walk between the towers and the wind assists me.

lines.zh: 你退向墙角，落点正好。
lines.en: Back into the corner; that suits my landing.

lines.zh: 甲再厚，头顶那一块总是薄的。
lines.en: However thick the plate, the crown stays thin.

lines.zh: 我不急着落，翅膀还能撑十息。
lines.en: I am in no rush; the wings hold ten more breaths.

lines.zh: 你换手拿武器时，肩会开。
lines.en: When you switch hands, your shoulder opens.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声风，是翼尖。
lines.en: That gust you hear is a wingtip.

lines.zh: 我在等你走出屋檐的边线。
lines.en: I wait for you to step past the eaves' edge.

lines.zh: 你抬头太频繁，脖子会酸。
lines.en: You look up too often; your neck will ache.

lines.zh: 血五十，够我摔一次再打。
lines.en: Fifty hearts: enough to crash once and keep fighting.

lines.zh: 这一圈，我把你的退路都数了。
lines.en: This circle counted every one of your exits.

lines.zh: 别往桥下看，我在上面。
lines.en: Do not look below the bridge; I am above.

lines.zh: 我在你正上方，风把我压低。
lines.en: I hang right above you; the wind presses me lower.

lines.zh: 等你走到桥心，四面都没遮挡。
lines.en: Wait until you reach mid-bridge, with nothing overhead.

lines.zh: 从九格高落下，这一剑带着体重。
lines.en: Dropping nine blocks, this blade carries my weight.

lines.zh: 俯冲的力道，你挡得住刃挡不住风。
lines.en: You stop the edge but not the wind behind the dive.

lines.zh: 落地时我滚了一圈，剑没停。
lines.en: I roll on landing, and the blade never stops.

lines.zh: 翼尖先到，剑后到，你选哪个。
lines.en: Wingtip first, blade second; take your pick.

lines.zh: 这一击是从你背后来的。
lines.en: This one came from behind you.

lines.zh: 百格追来，总要落在你身上。
lines.en: A hundred paces of chase ends on your back.

lines.zh: 鞘翅张开时，我的身位低了一截。
lines.en: Wings out, my profile drops a notch.

lines.zh: 你抬盾的手太高，腋下空着。
lines.en: You lift that shield too high; your armpit is open.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，摔下来的才重。
lines.en: The blade is light; the fall is what hurts.

lines.zh: 我在你侧后落，不在正面。
lines.en: I land at your rear flank, never the front.

lines.zh: 甲上的凹痕，是落地撞的。
lines.en: These dents in my plate came from landings.

lines.zh: 追击没停，喘息留到之后。
lines.en: The pursuit continues; I breathe afterward.

lines.zh: 落地那一下，膝盖先撞上你。
lines.en: On landing, my knee hits you before the blade.

lines.zh: 翼膜收拢时夹住了你的盾。
lines.en: Folding the membrane caught the edge of your shield.

lines.zh: 塔顶的瓦响了一下，那就是我。
lines.en: A tile shifted on the spire; that was me.

lines.zh: 我从上面来，地面留给你。
lines.en: I come from above; the ground is yours.

lines.zh: 翅膀刚展开，风还没跟上。
lines.en: Wings just opened; the wind lags behind.

lines.zh: 这一片的空域，归我巡。
lines.en: This stretch of air is my patrol.

lines.zh: 你听见翼膜拍打，就晚了。
lines.en: Hear the membrane flap and you are already late.

lines.zh: 我从桥上方的缺口下来的。
lines.en: I came down through the gap above the bridge.

lines.zh: 落点选在你背后，不算偷袭。
lines.en: I chose the spot behind you; hardly a sneak attack.

lines.zh: 禁堡的塔，一座一座往下跳。
lines.en: Bastion towers, one after another, all jumped down.

lines.zh: 血厚，是为了摔得起。
lines.en: Thick blood means I can afford the crash.

lines.zh: 上次落点差两格，这次不会。
lines.en: Last time I missed by two blocks; not now.

lines.zh: 抬头吧，风已经转向你。
lines.en: Look up; the wind has turned toward you.

lines.zh: 我落地前，你已经该跑了。
lines.en: You should already be running before I land.

lines.zh: 下界的火，我早就不当回事。
lines.en: Nether fire stopped bothering me long ago.

lines.zh: 摔得重，但翅膀替我卸了大半。
lines.en: A hard landing, yet the wings took most of it.

lines.zh: 水太重，翅膀一下就成了石头。
lines.en: Water is heavy; the wings turn to stone.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得比跳还高。
lines.en: The blast threw me higher than a jump.

lines.zh: 箭穿进翼膜，漏风了。
lines.en: The arrow pierced the membrane; it leaks air.

lines.zh: 咒力缠住翼骨，展不开。
lines.en: Magic binds my wing bone; it will not open.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，翅膀先没力气。
lines.en: When hungry, the wings lose strength first.

lines.zh: 雷劈在翼骨上，火花顺着边跑。
lines.en: Lightning hit the wing bone and sparks ran its edge.

lines.zh: 下面没有底，翅膀也抓不住风。
lines.en: No bottom below; even wings find no air.
